user_input: Generate a prompt for determining the usable space of a ZFS pool containing 1 vdev consisting of 4 10TB disks in a raidz2 layout
model_output:
To determine the usable space of a ZFS pool containing 1 vdev consisting of 4 10TB disks in a raidz2 layout, you can use the following command:

`zfs list -vdev=@vdev | grep 'Data Space' | awk '{print $5}'`

This command will list all of the ZFS datasets in the pool, including the data and spare areas, and will display the total amount of usable space in each dataset. The output will show the total usable space of the vdev, which is the sum of the usable space in each of the 4 RAIDZ2 arrays.

Alternatively, you can use the following command to determine the usable space of the individual RAIDZ2 arrays:

`zfs list -vdev=@vdev | grep 'Data Space' | awk '{print $5}' | awk '{print $1}'`

This command will display the usable space of each RAIDZ2 array in the vdev, which is half of the total data space of the array.
